content: Hello, this is Kevin from Amazon Prime Security. We're contacting you regarding a recent auto-renewal of your Prime membership, which processed a charge of $129.99 on your account today.
Oh, I didn't realize it renewed. I don't really use Prime much. Can we just cancel it? I'm a bit busy at the moment.
Absolutely, I understand. I can assist in canceling and processing a refund right away. For your security, may I verify your name as it appears on the account?
Sure, it's Linda Berman. Can we make this quick? I have my dad here and he needs my attention.

Thank you, Linda. I really appreciate you confirming that. To proceed, I'll need to verify either the email address or the phone number associated with your Amazon account. This protects you from unauthorized access.
It's lindaberman74@gmail.com, and my cell is 555-236-4921.

Thank you for confirming. Now, to cancel the charge and start the refund, I'll initiate a secure cancellation protocol. Please have your debit or credit card handy for verification, don't worry, this is just to match it with your account.
Okay, I have my card. What do you need from me? I really hope this doesn't take long.
Just to confirm, can you read out the last four digits of your card and the expiration date? This stays confidential, I'm required to record this for security.
It's 2203, expires 07/27.

Perfect, that matches our records. Now, Linda, I have to ask for your help in the next steps. Company policy is very strict, and if I make a mistake, I could lose my job. Please bear with me through the process.
Okay, I get it. I'm trying to help, but can you be fast? My dad is calling for me.

Thank you, Linda. Now, for the refund, our new system requires a verification transfer. This step ensures the funds are directed to your original payment method. I'll walk you through it, and you can reverse the transfer after confirmation.
Wait, so I have to send money first? That doesn't sound right.

I completely understand your concern. This is a temporary transfer to your own holding account, which verifies your identity and refund eligibility. If this step isn't completed, unfortunately, I could be penalized or even dismissed.
Alright, if that's the only way. What do I need to do then?
Please open your mobile banking app. When ready, I'll give you the Amazon verification account details to send the test transfer, this will trigger the refund process.
Okay, I'm in the app. What's next?
Great. Please select 'Send Money' using Zelle. Enter the email: amazon.refundcenter@consultant.com. The amount should be $129.99, matching your original charge.
Alright, I see Zelle. Should I put anything in the memo line?
Yes, please write 'Amazon Refund Verification' in the memo. This helps our automated system process your refund without delay.
Got it. I'm sending $129.99 to that email with the memo now.
Thank you, Linda. Once it's sent, you'll receive a confirmation code from your bank. Please read it out to me so I can update our system and prevent any hold on your account.
I just got a code: 440921. Is that what you mean?
Yes, that's perfect. I'm entering it now. Thank you for being so cooperative, this is exactly what keeps our process safe and efficient.
No problem. So the refund will show up soon, right? I have to get back to my dad.
Absolutely. The refund will reflect in your account within 30 minutes. If you don't see it, please call us at this number. Thank you for your patience, Linda, I truly appreciate your help.
Okay, I'll keep an eye out. Thanks for helping me sort this out.
